sources.note: onchain review: victim 0x598c6c1cd9459f882530fc9d7da438cb74c6cb3b is the Rico BankDiamond, an EIP-2535 diamond whose facet code changes via DiamondCut and never emits an EIP-1967 Upgraded event; eth_getLogs over creation block 176310105 (2024-02-01) to incident block 202973713 finds five DiamondCut logs: two at deployment (2024-02-01T07:03:32Z and 07:03:51Z) and three in one tx 0x10c415ab45e3495c869d290a06b786b63b25ec25f3a3dc62c760f5bc852d0ccc at block 193149212, 2024-03-22T21:18:40Z, which removed seven selectors, added facet 0x254834c73e3070a674ea8059be3c813694070f06 and Replaced facets 0xc6d7b37fe18a3dd007f9b1c3b339b8c6043b3ccf (21 selectors, including flash(address,bytes) 0xa0a7930a, the exploited entry point) and 0x8dfb233ef877dd5a260a52eced01a0f7e160b7b2 (5 selectors); the age is therefore measured from that cut rather than the diamond deployment

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
The imported USD loss lacks structured valuation provenance.
